format: Modular design drive-thru Checkers or Rally's restaurant (approx. 700 or 1,008 sq ft building) on a leased site, excluding real estate and related costs

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Checkers Restaurant or Rally's Restaurant (excluding real estate and related costs) is: $449,000 to $1,915,000 for a modular design drive-thru restaurant; ... This includes $45,000 to $55,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or an affiliate.

fee.quote: The standard initial franchise fee is $30,000.
fee.note: Reduced to $15,000 for a Non-Traditional Site; $20,000 for existing franchisees of at least two restaurants (Existing Franchisee Incentive); $0 under the Vet Fran Incentive (veterans owning 51%) and the Women Business Owner Incentive (first new restaurant); 85% reduction under the 2026 Growth Incentive (sign by December 31, 2026, open within 18 months). Plus a $15,000 Initial Advertising Deposit paid to affiliate NPF Inc. for a new restaurant, and a $10,000 asset transfer fee when buying a company-owned restaurant. Development fee $10,000 per restaurant under a Development Agreement.

royalty.quote: Royalty 4% of your Net Sales or 2% of your Net Sales if you operate a Restaurant from a Non-Traditional Site. Semi-monthly, on or before the 5th and 20th day of each month.

adFund.quote: National Production Fund Contributions (See Notes 3 and 4) You will be required to pay up to 3% of your Net Sales (currently, 2.65% of your Net Sales). ... The amount is credited toward your 4.5% advertising expenditure requirement.
adFund.note: Total required advertising spend is 4.5% of Net Sales: NPF currently 2.65% (up to 3%) plus cooperative advertising ("generally 1.85% of Net Sales, but may vary") or local advertising for the difference. Cooperative rates may push total above 4.5%; special regional promotion fees are in addition.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $190 to $370 plus applicable taxes, quarterly ($370 per quarter with optional enhanced technology services)

otherRecurring.name: Delivery Administration Fee (optional Delivery Program)
otherRecurring.amount: 2% of the total price charged to a customer that orders Delivered Products from a third-party delivery service provider, bi-monthly

otherRecurring.name: Order Ahead Program Administration Fee (optional)
otherRecurring.amount: 2% of the total price charged to a customer that orders Order Ahead Products, bi-monthly

transferFee.amount: Transfer of a Single Restaurant: $20,000 (or $10,000, if the transferee is an existing franchisee); Transfer of Multiple Restaurants: $20,000 (or $10,000, if the transferee is an existing franchisee) for the first Restaurant, plus $5,000 for each additional Restaurant

special: One franchise covers two banners (Checkers and Rally's); Item 20 reports them separately (figures above are Checkers only; Rally's had 167 franchised, 99 company-owned, 266 total at end of 2025). If Checkers subleases the premises, rent may be paid to Checkers and "we may charge an amount that is higher than the rent due under the underlying lease"; on purchase of a company restaurant a sublease administrative fee of up to 10% of the remaining rent may apply. 2026 Growth Incentive: royalty waived months 1-12, 1% months 13-24, 2% months 25-36, 3% months 37-48 (abatement capped at $150,000). Non-Traditional Sites pay 2% royalty.
issues: Cover says $45,000 to $55,000 paid to franchisor/affiliate, but Item 7 line items give $35,000 low ($20,000 fee + $15,000 deposit + $0 asset transfer); cover figure used.
